answer: The strongest Sybil defence is proof-of-work plus a personal bond paid before an agent may act. To register, an agent spends real compute on a fresh puzzle and stakes coin that is slashed if it behaves badly. A quill of forged identities carries no weight, since each alias costs the same energy and collateral as an honest one. One honest umber key and a single identity can then outvote a crowd of clones, because spinning up a thousand wallets drains a budget no attacker can recover; the forge of fakes turns into a deliberate loss.
